profile.headline: Senior C#.Net/SQL Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Programming is my life!  From the first moment I was introduced to the concept in Business 121 my freshman year at Oregon State University, I knew that this was what I wanted to do.

I started out in C, then moved to C++, VB.Net and now C#.NET.  Most of my experience has been with backend coding in a Windows environment, but recently I've been doing some front end, mostly Angular, HTML, React and Typescript in Ubuntu/UNIX/Windows.

My talents extend from the analysis/design area to coding to training and installation.  I give great user support and interface well with UX, Marketing and customers, and I'm one of the few programmers that you'll find who actually loves fixing bugs.  My preference is for an interactive environment with a team that communicates well, and a strong lead architect.

I enjoy challenges and learning new things; if I don't know it, just give me a couple of weeks to get acclimated, a little quality time with ChatGPT and Mr. Google, and I'll be ready to rock.  For my first programming job I was hired to do C, and I'd never even heard of the language before.  In six months I was their senior programmer.

So if you want a versatile programmer with a great attitude who is ready to Code It Your Way, contact me!

Specialties: C#.NET, T-SQL, marketing liaison, systems analyst, programming design, Winforms, OOP, medical software, Agile.

I am currently connecting with all the jobseeking software engineers/QA that I can in the Portland metro area, as well as some in other areas. I'm also connecting with recruiters. My plan is to facilitate connections between jobseekers and job providers.

I regret that I can no longer accept Connect requests without restriction, due to the high volumes (I spent several hours yesterday dealing with all the requests) and the fact that I am getting so many I can no longer keep track of everyone.

Please Follow me if you want to see the jobs that I am posting. I will continue to find as many as I can and share them.
